Name: Love Festival
Author: AvalonMFX
Description:
This mod adds a new Festival called "Love Festival" to the game. It will take place every year on the 6th Winter.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/n9k82K7.png[/img]
[b]
[color=#6aa84f]﻿[size=5]Check the images to get a better overview[/size][/color][/b]

[list]
[*]After seeing the dialogue of datable NPCs, you can talk to them again in order to give them a love letter (+250 friendship points / +1 heart).[/*]
[*]You can [b]only give 1 letter[/b] per festival to an NPC.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]After talking to Lewis, datable NPCs [b]start giving you love letters.[/b] They contain various items such as [b]money, crops, food etc[/b][/*]
[*]The [b]more hearts[/b] you have with an NPC, [b]the higher[/b] the chance to receive a love letter from them ([b]+10% for each heart[/b], 2 hearts required at least, customisable)[/*]
[*]Spouses will [b]always[/b] give you their love letter[/*]
[*]A tent with a cupid allows you to buy a friendship booster for 1 week (20% more friendship points for the specific NPC)[/*]
[*]Chance to trigger a jealousy dialogue when giving your love letter to someone who is not your spouse[/*]
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/W1gSYfd.png[/img]﻿﻿

[list]
[*][color=#6aa84f]Mutliplayer compatible[/color] [color=#f4f4f4](All players can and will be able to receive and gift letters)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#bf9000]Compatible with modded NPCs[/color] [color=#f4f4f4](They won't appear on the map unless the creators added it but they will be able to gift you love letters. I tried with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6754]Aspen[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿. However, sometimes they get stuck during the event. If you experience bugs with modded NPCs during the festival, please exlude them from the festival in the Love Festival config. )[/color][/*]
[*][color=#bf9000]Mobile compatible[/color] [color=#f4f4f4](Used to work, now it's in an unknown state. I recommend downloading the normal file and writing a comment about the experience. If it works flawless, I will move the individual mobile version to the archive.)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#bf9000]Mac Compatible[/color][color=#f4f4f4] (Lewis' Dialogue to start the Festival won't show up. However, using the command '[/color][color=#b6b6b6][font=Trebuchet MS][b]start_lovefestival'[/b][/font][/color][color=#f4f4f4] will start the festival)[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#f4f4f4]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iXMEreT.png[/img]

[b]Sometimes, the translations that are suggested on this page by Nexus mods are outdated. I recommend you to get them from these links. I try to update them)[/b][/color]

[list]
[*]The dialogue bubble for giving the love letter doesnt appear right after talking to the npc (will appear after pressing right click / interacting with something, you can still interact with it though and gift the love letter)[/*]
[*]Modded NPCs may get stuck[/*]
[*]The custom debris won't work when it's snowing on the festival day[/*]
[*]If you've discovered any other bugs, please let me know[/*]
[/list]
